compatible_oracle_diagnostic.interpretation: Descriptive channel exceedance, using grid discrepancy as a proxy, without simultaneous coverage.

coverage.highlight_definition: Saved specular luminance >= .01 and >= 3 times the fitting-view median
coverage.interpretation: Nearby saved rays and same-face hits are coverage proxies. They do not measure point visibility or inversion conditioning.

draw_uncertainty: Paired whole-draw leave-one-out jackknife with t(63) intervals; excludes fixed diffuse quadrature, reference and spatial sampling uncertainty.
sign_convention: Intervened minus baseline; negative SSE effect is an improvement.
